P_CL2_L1.question: Zeige den Umsatz nach Rabatt pro Kundenland.

- USA: CHF 245,585
- Deutschland: CHF 230,285
- Österreich: CHF 128,004
- Brasilien: CHF 106,926
- Frankreich: CHF 81,358
- UK: CHF 58,971
- Venezuela: CHF 56,811

- Kanada: CHF 50,196
- Irland: CHF 49,980

Diese Liste zeigt die Top 10 Länder nach Umsatz. Wenn du weitere Details benötigst, lass es mich wissen!
P_CL2_L1.sql_query:
SELECT c.country, 
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue
FROM public.order_details od
JOIN public.orders o ON od.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN public.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

P_CL6_L1.sql_query:
SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS monat, 
    COUNT(order_id) AS anzahl_auftraege,
    SUM(CASE WHEN shipped_date > required_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS verspaetete_auslieferungen
FROM 
    public.orders

    monat

P_CL6_L3.sql_query:

    DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS month,
